scripts.lint: eslint cloudflare static/js scripts/cloudflare tests --ignore-pattern tests/run.php --ignore-pattern tests/init-http-db.php --ignore-pattern tests/http-integration.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write cloudflare static/js scripts/cloudflare tests/cloudflare tests/frontend tests/e2e web docs README.md package.json vercel.json .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check cloudflare static/js scripts/cloudflare tests/cloudflare tests/frontend tests/e2e web docs README.md package.json vercel.json .github
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/cloudflare/*.test.mjs tests/frontend/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:e2e
